target_cont.definition: eligible original target delta unknown, target_cont delta known; supplemental only

definitions.selection: Maximum per-record finished timestamp, falling back to started; timestamped records outrank missing/invalid timestamps. Naive timestamps use UTC+08:00. Ties: more observed mode results, then JUnit-bearing results, then delta-bearing results; explicit source priority resume rN > shardN-M > main (higher numeric generation/index wins); final tie uses canonical record SHA256. No filesystem mtime or enumeration-order overwrite.
definitions.delta: historical baseline-relative bad-set difference; clean does not mean repaired
definitions.absolute: local rc/JUnit positive-unskipped-test check; independent from delta and required coverage
definitions.required: all enumerated required tests must pass; unavailable list, XML gap, or unenumerated parametrization is unknown
definitions.independence: 129 task identities, repeated variants; no independent-task claim from state count; noop and revert share control family
definitions.official: official resolved not assessed: corpus lacks official required-test inventory and official runner receipts

legacy_sensitivity.selection: main then lexicographic source overwrite (historical only)
legacy_sensitivity.limitation: sensitivity reference; excludes unknown from paired agreement; not official repair score

h2_historical_proxy.limitation: historical issue/file-stem Jaccard proxy and gold-informed oracle; old ties may vary; not measured official retrieval or delivered context; pending fresh deterministic run
